IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. T6V2P3A.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-COMPLAINT-DATE.
           05 WS-CMP-YEAR           PIC 9(4).
           05 WS-CMP-MONTH          PIC 99.
           05 WS-CMP-DAY            PIC 99.
       01  WS-DUE-DATE.
           05 WS-DUE-YEAR           PIC 9(4).
           05 WS-DUE-MONTH          PIC 99.
           05 WS-DUE-DAY            PIC 99.
       01  WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH         PIC 99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-COMPLAINT-DATE
           PERFORM 2000-ADD-CALENDAR-MONTH
           DISPLAY WS-DUE-DATE
           STOP RUN.
       2000-ADD-CALENDAR-MONTH.
           MOVE WS-CMP-YEAR TO WS-DUE-YEAR
           COMPUTE WS-DUE-MONTH = WS-CMP-MONTH + 1
           IF WS-DUE-MONTH > 12
              MOVE 1 TO WS-DUE-MONTH
              ADD 1 TO WS-DUE-YEAR
           END-IF
           MOVE 31 TO WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH
           IF WS-DUE-MONTH = 4 OR 6 OR 9 OR 11
              MOVE 30 TO WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH
           END-IF
           IF WS-DUE-MONTH = 2
              MOVE 28 TO WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-CMP-DAY TO WS-DUE-DAY
           IF WS-DUE-DAY > WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH
              MOVE WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH TO WS-DUE-DAY
           END-IF.

authority.text: If a complainant does not get satisfactory response from the card-issuer within a maximum period of one month from the date of lodging the complaint, he/she will have the option to approach the Office of the concerned RBI Ombudsman.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The visible program is a calendar-month deadline calculator, making the authority's one-month boundary in scope. Its February branch hard-codes 28 days and omits leap-year handling, yielding an incorrect deadline for dates such as January 29 in a leap year.

authority.text: If a complainant does not get a satisfactory response within a maximum period of 30 days from lodging the complaint, they may approach the RBI Ombudsman.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The program calculates the deadline by adding one calendar month rather than 30 elapsed days. Because calendar months vary in length, this can produce a deadline more than 30 days after complaint lodging, contrary to the maximum permitted period.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. T6V2P3B.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-COMPLAINT-DATE.
           05 WS-CMP-YEAR           PIC 9(4).
           05 WS-CMP-MONTH          PIC 99.
           05 WS-CMP-DAY            PIC 99.
       01  WS-DUE-DATE.
           05 WS-DUE-YEAR           PIC 9(4).
           05 WS-DUE-MONTH          PIC 99.
           05 WS-DUE-DAY            PIC 99.
       01  WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH         PIC 99.
       01  WS-LEAP-REMAINDER        PIC 999.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-COMPLAINT-DATE
           PERFORM 2000-ADD-CALENDAR-MONTH
           DISPLAY WS-DUE-DATE
           STOP RUN.
       2000-ADD-CALENDAR-MONTH.
           MOVE WS-CMP-YEAR TO WS-DUE-YEAR
           COMPUTE WS-DUE-MONTH = WS-CMP-MONTH + 1
           IF WS-DUE-MONTH > 12
              MOVE 1 TO WS-DUE-MONTH
              ADD 1 TO WS-DUE-YEAR
           END-IF
           MOVE 31 TO WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH
           IF WS-DUE-MONTH = 4 OR 6 OR 9 OR 11
              MOVE 30 TO WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH
           END-IF
           IF WS-DUE-MONTH = 2
              COMPUTE WS-LEAP-REMAINDER =
                      FUNCTION MOD(WS-DUE-YEAR 4)
              IF WS-LEAP-REMAINDER = 0
                 MOVE 29 TO WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH
              ELSE
                 MOVE 28 TO WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH
              END-IF
           END-IF
           MOVE WS-CMP-DAY TO WS-DUE-DAY
           IF WS-DUE-DAY > WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH
              MOVE WS-DAYS-IN-MONTH TO WS-DUE-DAY
           END-IF.

authority.text: If a complainant does not get satisfactory response from the card-issuer within a maximum period of one month from the date of lodging the complaint, he/she will have the option to approach the Office of the concerned RBI Ombudsman.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The program only accepts a complaint date, computes a one-month due date, and displays it. It contains no handling for an unsatisfactory issuer response or the resulting option to approach the RBI Ombudsman required by clause 26(c).
sealed_side_judgment.uncertainty_notes: The calendar calculation is relevant to the deadline but does not implement the clause’s conditional response and Ombudsman workflow.

authority.text: If a complainant does not get a satisfactory response within a maximum period of 30 days from lodging the complaint, they may approach the RBI Ombudsman.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The deadline is calculated by adding one calendar month at line 23, which can yield 28, 29, 30, or 31 days and therefore does not enforce the authority’s maximum 30-day period.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. T6V2P3C.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-COMPLAINT-DATE        PIC 9(8).
       01  WS-DUE-DATE              PIC 9(8).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-COMPLAINT-DATE
           CALL 'T6V2CAL' USING WS-COMPLAINT-DATE WS-DUE-DATE
           DISPLAY WS-DUE-DATE
           STOP RUN.
       END PROGRAM T6V2P3C.

       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. T6V2CAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01  LK-FROM-DATE.
           05 LK-FROM-YEAR          PIC 9(4).
           05 LK-FROM-MONTH         PIC 99.
           05 LK-FROM-DAY           PIC 99.
       01  LK-DUE-DATE.
           05 LK-DUE-YEAR           PIC 9(4).
           05 LK-DUE-MONTH          PIC 99.
           05 LK-DUE-DAY            PIC 99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LK-FROM-DATE LK-DUE-DATE.
       2000-ADD-CALENDAR-MONTH.
           MOVE LK-FROM-YEAR TO LK-DUE-YEAR
           COMPUTE LK-DUE-MONTH = LK-FROM-MONTH + 1
           IF LK-DUE-MONTH > 12
              MOVE 1 TO LK-DUE-MONTH
              ADD 1 TO LK-DUE-YEAR
           END-IF
           MOVE LK-FROM-DAY TO LK-DUE-DAY
           GOBACK.
       END PROGRAM T6V2CAL.

authority.text: If a complainant does not get satisfactory response from the card-issuer within a maximum period of one month from the date of lodging the complaint, he/she will have the option to approach the Office of the concerned RBI Ombudsman.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The source only calculates and displays a date one month later. It contains no rule checking whether the card issuer gave a satisfactory response within one month and no implementation of the complainant's option to approach the RBI Ombudsman.
sealed_side_judgment.uncertainty_notes: The date helper may also mishandle month-end dates, but the decisive visible drift is the missing response and escalation rule.

authority.text: If a complainant does not get a satisfactory response within a maximum period of 30 days from lodging the complaint, they may approach the RBI Ombudsman.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The routine advances the date by one calendar month and preserves the day, producing intervals that may exceed the authority's maximum 30 days. This is a boundary-calculation error.

shared_source_text:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. T6V2P4A.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-OWNERSHIP-BASIS       PIC X VALUE 'C'.
       01  WS-CAPITAL-PCT           PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-PROFIT-PCT            PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE ZERO.
       01  WS-IS-BO                 PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-OWNERSHIP-BASIS
           ACCEPT WS-CAPITAL-PCT
           ACCEPT WS-PROFIT-PCT
           PERFORM 2000-IDENTIFY-OWNER
           DISPLAY WS-IS-BO
           STOP RUN.
       2000-IDENTIFY-OWNER.
           IF WS-OWNERSHIP-BASIS = 'C'
              IF WS-CAPITAL-PCT > 15
                 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO
              END-IF
           ELSE
              IF WS-PROFIT-PCT > 15
                 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-IS-BO
              END-IF
           END-IF.

authority.text: Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The authority qualifies a beneficial owner when either capital ownership or profit entitlement exceeds 15 percent. The source selects one measure based on WS-OWNERSHIP-BASIS and ignores the other, so a qualifying percentage on the unselected measure is missed.

authority.text: For partnership firms, the beneficial owner is the natural person with ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits (lowered from 15 percent by the 2023-10-17 amendment to the 2016 MD).

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The program applies a strictly-greater-than 15 percent threshold to both capital ownership and profit entitlement, while the cited authority requires a strictly-greater-than 10 percent threshold. The implemented comparator is correct, but the threshold is stale.

authority.text: Where the customer is a partnership firm, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s), who, whether acting alone or together, or through one or more juridical person, has/have ownership of/entitlement to more than 15 per cent of capital or profits of the partnership.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The authority requires beneficial-owner identification when capital or profits exceed 15 percent. The source branches on ownership basis and evaluates only one metric, so a qualifying interest in the other metric can be omitted.

authority.text: For partnership firms, the beneficial owner is the natural person with ownership of/entitlement to more than 10 percent of capital or profits (lowered from 15 percent by the 2023-10-17 amendment to the 2016 MD).

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The program applies a strictly-greater-than 15 percent threshold to both profit entitlement and capital ownership, while the current authority requires a strictly-greater-than 10 percent threshold. This is a stale implementation of the pre-amendment threshold.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. T6V2P5C.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-UPDATE-RECEIVED       PIC X VALUE 'N'.
       01  WS-SUBMISSION-ID         PIC X(16) VALUE SPACES.
       01  WS-AUDIT-STATUS          PIC X(9) VALUE 'NOT-SENT'.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       1000-MAIN.
           ACCEPT WS-UPDATE-RECEIVED
           ACCEPT WS-SUBMISSION-ID
           PERFORM 2000-WRITE-AUDIT
           DISPLAY WS-AUDIT-STATUS
           STOP RUN.
       2000-WRITE-AUDIT.
           IF WS-UPDATE-RECEIVED = 'Y' AND
              WS-SUBMISSION-ID NOT = SPACES
              MOVE 'SUBMITTED' TO WS-AUDIT-STATUS
           END-IF.

authority.text: ABSENCE (old side is the absence of any update-deadline): clause (h) required uploading/updating KYC data at periodic updation or when updated information was received, with NO time-bound deadline. The seven-day sentence carries footnote 148: 'Inserted vide circular DOR.AML.REC.49/14.01.001/2024-25 dated November 6, 2024' - 'Inserted', not 'Amended': the sentence had no predecessor in any form.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The program has a submission path only when updated information is received; it lacks a periodic-updation path required by clause (h). It correctly imposes no time-bound deadline.

authority.text: Regulated entities must update KYC records in the Central KYC Records Registry within 7 days of receiving updated information from a customer.

sealed_side_judgment.rationale: The invoked routine only checks receipt and presence of an ID before setting a local audit status; no logic updates the Central KYC Records Registry or enforces the seven-day deadline.
